# Project Instructions

## Project
Dancing with the SARs - NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.
We explore real NISAR SAR data to analyse and visualize
changes on Earth's surface over time.

## Technology
- Python
- NumPy and SciPy
- Rasterio and GDAL
- GeoPandas
- ESA SNAP
- QGIS
- Streamlit, if suitable

## Coding Standards
- Write modular, readable Python code.
- Use meaningful names and docstrings.
- Validate inputs and handle errors.
- Include tests for important functions.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Explain significant algorithmic decisions.

## Scientific Integrity
- Never invent satellite data or experimental results.
- Distinguish real data from simulated data.
- Explain the mathematics behind algorithms.
- Preserve units, coordinate systems and metadata.
- Do not claim scientific validation just because code runs.

## Collaboration
- Work within your assigned module.
- Do not overwrite another member's work.
- Discuss changes to shared interfaces.
- Use separate branches and pull requests.
- Keep modules compatible with the project.
